baseline: H0: existing residual momentum EWMA alpha=0.25
B00: existing prior-only 250-observation high-breakout Long / low-breakout Short, EWMA alpha=0.25
CHANNEL_250_001: signed 250-observation channel position, EWMA alpha=0.25

trials.description: Absolute value of the existing smoothed B00 score
Absolute value of the existing smoothed channel-position score

transform_definition.order: Apply abs after the existing EWMA alpha=0.25 score. Do not smooth again.
transform_definition.B00_ABS: abs(B00 EWMA score); both new-high and new-low breakouts are positive, non-breakout zero remains zero.
transform_definition.CHANNEL_250_ABS: abs(channel_position_250 EWMA score); both high-side and low-side channel extremes are positive.
transform_definition.portfolio_interpretation: The existing five-quantile portfolio engine ranks the positive transformed scores. High absolute tails can enter Long; low-absolute middle/zero rows can enter Short.

feature_definitions.B00: Existing prior-only split-safe 250-observation high breakout Long / low breakout Short score, smoothed with EWMA alpha=0.25.
feature_definitions.channel_position_250: Existing prior-only 250-observation channel-position score, high=+1 and low=-1, smoothed with EWMA alpha=0.25.
feature_definitions.absolute_transform: Elementwise absolute value of the existing smoothed score. No new feature calculation or target input.

model: No fitted predictor. Use abs of the already smoothed signed score as cross-sectional score; same official five-quantile portfolio evaluation.

selection_rule.primary: Descriptive Train-only comparison; no selection because all periods are known.
